{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"The castle crowns the hill with murals, marble halls, and a view that makes the whole city feel like a rumour below."},{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"Casa Azul wraps you in cobalt walls, garden greens, and Frida's fierce, tender world."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The heart of the city, where the flag waves over centuries of comings and goings."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Layers of the old city peek out beside the cathedral, a quiet echo of the Mexica."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A market where the city's cooks come for the good stuff, from chiles to the unexpected."},{"poi_id":"p14","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Tiny tacos al pastor carved straight from the trompo, a classic worth the squeeze."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Glide the old canals on a painted trajinera, mariachi drifting over the water."},{"poi_id":"p16","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A bright seafood room where the tuna tostadas deserve their fame."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Wander the bosque's shaded paths and watch the city breathe."},{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Stroll Roma's leafy streets, all art deco facades and easy corners."},{"poi_id":"p17","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A slow, surprising tasting menu that turns Mexican ingredients into theatre."}]}
